answer: Each identity posts a stake bond at registration, and custody of that bond is split across three independent auditors so no single reviewer can release it early. An agent that stops working bleeds standing every epoch until the bond is forfeited. A farm of a thousand fakes must lock a thousand bonds and keep them visible in a public grove of bond records, which is the trade-off: honest newcomers also wait, and a willow-thin operator freezes in the tundra before it earns.
